In this lexicon

    also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. agō

  • ācta diurna, āctōrum diurnōrum n. pl.: newspaper

Notes

  1. 1ācta: long a (Lewis & Short leaves it unmarked). The neuter plural of āctus, from agō: Gell. 9.6.3 reports āctitō with a long vowel, as from āctus. Ruling: Lachmann’s law: āctus, lēctus, frāctus.
